neighbours.label: the target or scoring zone in a ball game (the ' goal', ' basket', penalty ' area', the other team's ' line') named as where the ball or player is headed
fire: The winger crossed the ball and the captain headed it into the goal.
The guard dribbled past two defenders and drove straight to the basket.
A foul committed by a defender inside the penalty area results in a penalty kick.
In rugby a try is scored by grounding the ball behind the opponents' goal line.
The forward slid the puck under the goalie and into the net.
A dunk is a shot in which the player pushes the ball down through the basket.
The keeper may not pick up the ball once he has left his own penalty area.
The midfielder took a long shot that flew just over the goal.
quiet: The winger and the captain signed new contracts with the club on Friday.
The guard has played for three different teams in the last five seasons.
Her main goal for the summer is to finish writing the novel.
She carried the washing out to the garden in a wicker basket.
The forward gave a long interview to the local newspaper after training.
Parking is not allowed in the area behind the town library.
The keeper was named player of the year by the supporters.
The midfielder missed four weeks of the season with a sore knee.

notes: Card: peaks ' goal' x6, ' the' x5, ' basket' x3, ' area' x2 in rule and glossary text about basketball, football and hockey. Probes: 'kicked the ball into the goal' 0.70, 'close to the basket' 0.61, 'penalty area' 0.85, 'the other team's line' 0.71; non-sport 'My goal this year' 0.01, 'apples in the basket' 0.03.
